title: Footer Navigation
description: The terms nav in the footer colophon — live's `nav#footer-navigation` holding Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions. Measured on live 2026-08-20: 14px regular type, `#847C73`, brightening to `#DCD6C9`, with a 1px × 14px vertical rule between the two items. Colour follows styles/sections/footer-colophon.json rather than live's literal values, for the contrast reason recorded there: `neutral-400` resting (6.33:1 on the colophon ground, against live's failing 2.54:1) and `brand-400` on hover (5.75:1) — orange, like every footer link since 2026-09-23, in place of live's `neutral-300`. Type is font-size 200 at regular weight — live's 14px against the credit line's 15px is a one-pixel difference that does not warrant a second token. The dividing rule needs `content: ""`, `::after` and `:not(:last-child)`, none of which survive a `css` field, so it lives in assets/styles/core-navigation.css alongside the hover rule that core's `color: inherit` reset forces out of here too. Uses the structured elements.link + :hover form (like core/query-pagination) rather than the css field, since the css field strips :hover. Note that the gap between the items is **not** set here: a variation's `spacing.blockGap` is not emitted as the flex layout gap, so declaring it here silently did nothing and the nav inherited spacing 60 (37px measured). It is set on the block in patterns/footer.php instead, as spacing 30 — live's 20px — and the dividing rule halves the same token.
